Figure 81 Leader Board part 2 
 
Here you can see the leaderboard and where you place within it. Along the top 
you can see your current rank. There are three ranks bronze silver and gold, to 
progress into the next rank you need to place within the top three. To be 
demoted you need to be within the bottom two players. Within any one league 
there are 30 players in total. 
The top three players are highlighted in light blue. As well as this you are also 
highlighted in a light blue. Players to be demoted are highlighted in red.
